name: Surreal
description: A familiar card in colors and a radius that should not meet.
bestFor: Art-led pages that should feel slightly impossible.
promptFragment: Visual style: Surreal. Keep a normal card structure, then pair colors and shapes that do not belong together: deep teal, gold, burgundy, and an oversized radius with a displaced shadow. Type stays a plain serif so the mismatch is in the color and the form. Avoid a harmonious brand palette and a neat symmetric system. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
